scoring_justification: Sweeps recomputed from formulas; B parameters compared to paper-reported gold (T0) because raw experimental data is not bundled.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for fitted B parameters (B, B_max, B_I, B_N) for four nanocomposites
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's reported fitted B values (chitosan:86.4, polysilsesquioxane:132.9, PVA:17.18, PET:33.34) and computed B_max from Eq.(6) with R=15 nm and matrix strengths (69.1, 75 MPa). PVA/PET B_max set to 0 (not applicable).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and reproduced in solve.sh reference.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported numbers, directly traceable to Section 3 and Fig. 1.
